one_liner: EmotesR adds a configurable emote selector UI, enabling quick access to custom avatar emotes via a floating button and hotkey shortcuts.
primary_use_case: Provides players with a UI button and keyboard shortcuts to trigger multiple custom emotes in-world.
preview_recommendation: Add a screenshot or short video showing the floating UI button and the emote selector in action to improve discoverability.
manifest_quality_notes: Emotes are loaded as separate glb assets
Requires admin to enable custom avatars
